title: The Tusken Raider Camp
front_description: After a long search for the Tusken Raiders, Anakin finally comes upon their camp at nightfall. He senses his still-living mother in one of the huts, and cuts through it with his lightsaber. Dying, the freed Shmi looks into her beloved son's eyes and smiles. Then she goes limp in his arms. What happens next alerts the Tusken guards to Anakin's lethal presence...and tragic, profoundly dark events soon follow.
back_description: Hayden Christensen, as a vengeful Anakin, emerges from the Tusken Hut.
